title: Mirror Life
description: Build a cell the wrong way round and nothing alive can touch it, for good or ill. A 2024 warning, and the Antiverse's hazard. Unlocks the Mirror Culture Vat.

puzzle.goal: A batch is a share p mirror-handed, in a volume V, and the rest natural. Write the amount M of mirror cells, as p times V.
puzzle.name: Pure yield
puzzle.ask: Find M for p = @{p}, V = @{V} and w = @{w}.
puzzle.method: The pure share times the volume, less what is wasted; the vat needs p near one, since natural cells poison the rest.
